upscale_factor.label: Scale
upscale_factor.info: How many times bigger the picture becomes.

scale_factor.label: Scale
scale_factor.info: How many times bigger the picture becomes.

scale.label: Scale
scale.info: How many times bigger the picture becomes.

factor.label: Scale
factor.info: How many times bigger the picture becomes.

upscale_mode.label: Size by
upscale_mode.info: Choose a number of times bigger, or a target size such as 1080p.

target_resolution.label: Target size
target_resolution.info: The size you want the result to reach, such as 1080p or 4K.

enhance_model.label: Best for
enhance_model.info: The kind of picture the model is tuned for, such as normal photos, low-quality pictures or graphics.

model.label: Version
model.info: Which version of the model to use.

variant.label: Cut-out type
variant.info: Which kind of cut-out to make. Portrait is best for people, general for anything.

strength.label: Strength
strength.info: How strongly the model changes the picture. Low keeps it close to the original.

creativity.label: Creativity
creativity.info: How much new detail the model may add. Low stays true to the original.

denoise.label: Clean up grain
denoise.info: Removes grain and noise from the picture.

sharpen.label: Sharpness
sharpen.info: Makes edges and fine detail crisper.

fix_compression.label: Fix blockiness
fix_compression.info: Smooths the blocky marks left by heavy compression, common in saved or shared pictures.

noise_scale.label: Smoothness
noise_scale.info: How much grain is added back. Higher looks more natural, lower looks cleaner.

crop_to_fill.label: Fill the frame
crop_to_fill.info: Crops the edges so the picture fills the new size with no empty space.

face_enhancement_creativity.label: Face detail
face_enhancement_creativity.info: How much new detail the model may add to faces. Low keeps faces true to the original.

subject_detection.label: Focus on
subject_detection.info: Which part of the picture to improve: everything, only the main subject or only the background.

handfix.label: Fix Hands
handfix.info: Redraws hands that the upscale could distort.

sd_model.label: Look
sd_model.info: The kind of picture the model draws in: a realistic photo, a natural photo or flat and anime art.

dynamic.label: Contrast
dynamic.info: How punchy the picture looks. Higher adds more contrast and detail.

resemblance.label: Resemblance
resemblance.info: How closely the result stays like your original. Higher stays closer.

tiling_width.label: Tile Width
tiling_width.info: The size of each piece the picture is worked on in. Bigger is smoother but slower.

tiling_height.label: Tile Height
tiling_height.info: The size of each piece the picture is worked on in. Bigger is smoother but slower.

downscaling.label: Shrink First
downscaling.info: Shrinks a very large picture before upscaling, which is faster.

downscaling_resolution.label: Shrink Size
downscaling_resolution.info: How small the picture is made before upscaling.

pattern.label: Seamless Pattern
pattern.info: Makes the result repeat without visible seams, for patterns and textures.

scheduler.label: Sampler
scheduler.info: The method the model uses to draw. The default suits most pictures.

lora_links.label: Extra Styles
lora_links.info: Links to add-on styles that change how the picture looks.

custom_sd_model.label: Own Model
custom_sd_model.info: A model file of your own to draw with.

light_direction.label: Light from
light_direction.info: Where the new light comes from.

light_source.label: Light from
light_source.info: Where the new light comes from.

light_type.label: Kind of light
light_type.info: The look of the light, such as sunrise, spotlight or soft daylight.

style.label: Style
style.info: The look to repaint the picture in.

image_style.label: Style
image_style.info: The look to repaint the picture in.

style_strength.label: Style strength
style_strength.info: How strongly the style is applied. Low keeps more of the original.

structure_strength.label: Keep shapes
structure_strength.info: How closely the original shapes and layout are kept. High keeps them almost exactly.

aspect_ratio.label: Shape
aspect_ratio.info: The proportions of the picture, such as square or wide.

image_size.label: Size
image_size.info: The size or shape of the result.

size.label: Size
size.info: The size or shape of the result.

resolution.label: Size
resolution.info: How big the result is, in pixels. Bigger looks sharper and costs more.

quality.label: Quality
quality.info: Higher quality takes longer and may cost more.

outpaint.label: Expand by
outpaint.info: How the picture is extended past its edges: all sides, one side or to a square.

mask_blur.label: Edge softness
mask_blur.info: How soft the edge of the cut-out is.

mask_offset.label: Edge size
mask_offset.info: Makes the cut-out a little bigger or smaller at the edge.

refine_fg.label: Clean edges
refine_fg.info: Refines the cut-out edge, helpful for hair and fine detail.

num_inference_steps.label: Steps
num_inference_steps.info: How many passes the model makes. More is slower and can be better.

guidance_scale.label: Follow the words
guidance_scale.info: How closely the model follows your description.

output_format.label: File type
output_format.info: The kind of file you get back.

low resolution v2.label: Low resolution
low resolution v2.info: Improves low-resolution pictures such as web graphics and screenshots.

cgi.label: Art and CGI
cgi.info: For digital art, 3D renders, logos and icons.

high fidelity v2.label: High fidelity
high fidelity v2.info: Keeps fine detail in sharp, high-resolution pictures.

text refine.label: Text refine
text refine.info: Sharpens text and branding so it stays readable.

all.label: Everything
all.info: Finds every subject and improves each one.

foreground.label: Main subject
foreground.info: Improves the person or object in front.

background.label: Background
background.info: Improves what is behind the subject.

none.label: Whole picture
none.info: Treats the picture as one, with no subject found.

factor.label: Times bigger
factor.info: Make the picture 2x, 4x and so on bigger.

target.label: Target size
target.info: Reach a size such as 1080p or 4K.

disabled.label: Off
disabled.info: Leaves hands as the upscale draws them.

image_and_hands.label: Picture And Hands
image_and_hands.info: Improves the whole picture and fixes the hands.

fast.label: Fast
fast.info: Quicker and cheaper, a little less refined.

automatic.label: Find it for me
automatic.info: The model finds what to change.

side.label: Side
side.info: Light from the left or right.

zoom out 1.5x.label: Zoom out 1.5x
zoom out 1.5x.info: Adds room around all sides, 1.5 times wider.

zoom out 2x.label: Zoom out 2x
zoom out 2x.info: Adds room around all sides, twice as wide.

make square.label: Make square
make square.info: Extends the short sides to make a square.

left outpaint.label: Extend left
left outpaint.info: Adds new picture on the left.

right outpaint.label: Extend right
right outpaint.info: Adds new picture on the right.

editor.Exposure: Makes the whole picture lighter or darker.
editor.Contrast: The difference between the light and dark parts. Higher looks punchier.
editor.Brightness: Makes the picture lighter or darker without changing the strongest highlights as much.
editor.Highlights: Brings down or lifts only the brightest parts.
editor.Shadows: Brightens or deepens only the darkest parts.
editor.Saturation: How strong the colours are. Zero is black and white.
editor.Hue rotation: Shifts every colour around the colour wheel.
editor.Tint: Shifts the picture towards green or pink.
editor.Luminance: How light or dark that colour is.
editor.Straighten: Turns the picture a little to level the horizon.
editor.Rotate: Turns around the picture. For light, the side it comes from.
editor.Elevation: How high the light is, from below to above the subject.
editor.Vertical: Moves the camera up or down.
editor.Zoom: Moves the camera closer or further away.
editor.Sepia: Gives a warm brown, old-photo tone.
editor.Sharpen: Makes edges and fine detail crisper.
editor.Smart grain: Adds fine film-like grain so skin does not look plastic.
editor.Creativity: How much new detail the model may add. Low stays true to the original.
editor.Resemblance: How closely the result stays like your original.
editor.Fractality: How much fine, repeating detail is added to textures.
editor.Presets: Ready-made combinations of the settings below.
editor.Optimized for: The kind of picture to tune the result for.
editor.Version: How closely the result stays to your original look.
